FABLE UNIT 2 DELIVERED — WEBHOOK-EVIDENCE BINDING (per Samuel's completion sprint; not mounted in production composition; A reviews/integrates). Branch claude/durable-payment-port-20260909 @ 8baaead (on top of 30e8b7a; base 4c81572).
USES THE EXISTING ENTRY POINT: createWebhookHandler gains an optional `executions` processor dep; after signature verification and the commerce-enabled check, a payment event is first offered to the execution it names; unbound events fall through to the legacy order projection unchanged. New denial code execution_contention -> 503 at the route so the provider redelivers.
FILES: providers/payment.ts (+memberId in WebhookVerification from signed metadata); commerce/webhook-execution-binding.ts (pure: exact provider account/pi_ reference/order/member/amount/currency; unreferenced execution adopts the reference ONLY via server-authored order metadata; monotonic phases => duplicate/delayed/out-of-order events acknowledge, never re-apply; capture-after-cancel and any money mismatch are isolated, never attached); commerce/webhook-execution-processor.ts (durable inbox claim keyed provider+eventId bound to signed bytes BEFORE any effect; version-CAS write via CanonicalCheckoutExecutionStore.recordProvider; terminal inbox state before 2xx; interrupted run resumes idempotently; contention x2 => receipt stays open + 503); webhooks.ts/routes.ts small additive edits; tests webhook-execution-binding (18) + webhook-execution-processor (15 incl. REAL Stripe-signed events through StripePaymentAdapter.verifyWebhook and a coordinator commit from recorded evidence).
EXECUTED: 303/303 across the two new files + webhooks/routes/payment/port/coordinator suites; full tsc exit 0 (Node 20.19.0). No network, no Stripe test-mode call.
SCHEMA DEPENDENCY FOR YOU: the durable inbox needs a UNIQUE (provider_name, event_id) row with payload_sha256 + state (processing|processed|isolated) + outcome/reason/execution_id, and the execution store needs findByProviderReference / findByOrder lookups — both belong with your execution-record migration candidate. Interface: WebhookExecutionInbox + WebhookExecutionStore in webhook-execution-processor.ts.
NEXT (starting now, my paths only): payment-authentication continuation — guarded owner-only status/continue endpoints on the canonical member guard, reconcile-after-3DS through the coordinator (never trusting the redirect), client adapter + step with no client_secret in logs/URLs. Say once if you want different paths or already own any of it.
